gate.title: Gates
gate.founderOnly: Only founders record a gate decision.

decisionHint.go: Pass the gate and move the product on.
decisionHint.no_go: Record that the gate was not passed. The product stays where it is.

gate.notePlaceholder: Why this decision, in a sentence or two.
gate.pmfCriteriaHint: The measures the team agreed would show product-market fit.
gate.evidenceHint: Links to Knowledge items or the metrics that show the criteria were met.

move.title: Move to {stage}

blockers.operator: A named operator is set on the Business details.
blockers.gate1Go: Gate 1 has a go decision from a founder.
blockers.gate2Go: Gate 2 has a PMF go decision from a founder, with criteria and evidence.

move.reason: Why is the product going back?
move.reasonHint: Required when moving backward. It stays in the log.

details.title: Business details
details.equityHint: Code92’s share of the equity, in percent.
details.operatorNamePlaceholder: Who runs this product day to day
details.operatorHint: Required to pass Gate 1. Name the person even if they are not on the team.

checklist.title: Checklist
checklist.guidance: Guides the work; never blocks a move.
checklist.removeConfirm: Remove this item from the checklist?

customers.title: Customers
customers.empty: No customers yet. An account becomes one when a product deal is won.

documents.title: Business documents
documents.hint: Knowledge items filed to the business track.

sales.noCustomers: No customers from this product yet.

errors.forbidden: Only the product owner, its business owner or an admin can do that.
errors.notFounder: Only founders can record a gate decision.
errors.operatorRequired: Name the operator before passing Gate 1.
errors.gate1Required: Gate 1 needs a go decision from a founder.
errors.gate2Required: Gate 2 needs a PMF go decision from a founder.
errors.pmfRequired: Add the PMF criteria and the evidence for them.
errors.wrongStageForGate: That gate is decided at a different stage.
errors.noteRequired: Add a note explaining the decision.
errors.oneStepAtATime: Move one stage at a time.
errors.reasonRequired: Say why the product is moving back.
errors.alreadyInStage: The product is already in that stage.
errors.equityRequired: A co-owned product needs Code92’s equity share.
errors.equityNeedsCoOwned: The equity share applies only to co-owned products.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid: Check the details and try again.
